title: The starter preset, from a published registry
summary: A new project now starts the way a user starts it: npx create-nx-workspace with Architect's preset. The preset writes the starter (sign-up and sign-in on Better Auth, organisations, memberships, invitations and API keys, with five journeys) and renders its generated code under the new name. Architect's nine packages build to JavaScript and are published to a real Verdaccio registry in Docker for the check.
proves: In a fresh temporary folder, with Architect installed only from the local registry, create-nx-workspace makes the project, architect check passes, and architect prove passes five journeys and eleven operations with nine evals each, signing people in through Better Auth on workerd and D1.
